name: task-line
description: One clean line per task list above the prompt, filled from Claude's own todo tools, same look in the terminal and the desktop app

lingerSeconds.title: Finished list stays (seconds)
lingerSeconds.description: How long a finished list stays in the line, in seconds. 0 never shows a finished list. A value outside the allowed range is set to the nearest allowed one.

joinSeconds.title: New task joins (seconds)
joinSeconds.description: How long after a list finished a new task of the same name still joins it, in seconds. It joins only while the list is shown. 0 never joins. A value outside the allowed range is set to the nearest allowed one.
